start.content: Thomas. Ask more questions than I answer. The honest ones. Jesus told a story: tenants kept killing those the owner sent. Eventually, they killed the owner's son. If you heard that in court, the men are guilty. The crowd hearing it said, 'May this never be.' The stone the builders rejected became the cornerstone. The crowd does not always look where it points.

choices.text: Who are the tenants, in your reading?
What does the rejected stone become?
